changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Normalize text editing without importing product-specific configuration.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: Formatting is deterministic across the declared text surface.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Normalize repository text and generated-file diff behavior.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: Git attributes preserve LF text and mark the package lock as generated.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Define the closed workspace equality-input transport schema.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: The migration checker recomputes and matches every bound digest.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Define repository-owned computed rewrite evidence for one target objective.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: The migration checker rejects trusted booleans, missing oracle evidence, and unclassified changed surfaces.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Define the closed target projection schema without duplicating the workspace ledger authority.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: The migration checker rejects missing, unknown, stale, or foreign projection fields.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Exclude dependencies, build output, coverage, local environment, and temporary evidence without hiding canonical repository files.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: The policy suite rejects tracked dependency/generated directories and accepts the exact ignore boundary.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Declare the Roastery repository role and route contributors without importing Plugin, evaluator, benchmark, or personal-data ownership.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: The role-boundary suite accepts only Roastery contract, validator, empty-seed, publication, governance, and documentation surfaces.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Explain the official Bean-free Roastery contract and seed repository without claiming that contract or seed implementation already exists.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: The role-boundary suite confirms the README states the current governance-only status and forbids personal/sample Beans.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Provide a role-specific private vulnerability-reporting route and public external-data threat boundary.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: The role-boundary suite confirms security reporting, no secrets in issues, and Roastery-only scope.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Carry the exact immutable workspace equality-input receipt bytes into the target.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: The workspace and target copies are byte-identical and all digests recompute.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Record target-computed rewrite and changed-surface evidence for this governance objective.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: Target CI recomputes all evidence and rejects a stale or self-asserted success.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Transport only the selected canonical ledger rows and complete changed-surface classifications into the protected target.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: Repeated workspace generation produces exact byte equality and the target checker validates the projection.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Pin the minimal governance verification toolchain reproducibly.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: npm ci reproduces dependencies and leaves no tracked dependency directory.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Expose only deterministic governance verification commands for the Roastery trust base.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: npm ci, format:check, typecheck, test, and ci:policy all pass without network or provider secrets after installation.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Define one minimal deterministic formatting policy for governance bytes.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: npm run format:check passes on the complete branch.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Compute migration projection, equality, rewrite-oracle, and exhaustive changed-surface evidence rather than trusting declarations.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: The governance suite proves fail-closed behavior for unknown, missing, mismatched, and unavailable evidence.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Verify workflow, permission, pinning, migration evidence, and secret-boundary failure modes at the public contract level.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: Objective scenarios fail on an unsafe synthetic or repository state and pass on the complete trust base.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Prevent the Roastery governance bootstrap from owning Plugin runtime, personal Beans, evaluator execution, or benchmark implementation.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: The repository tree and declared role pass the allowlist and forbidden-surface scenarios.

changed_surface_classification.objective_or_failure_mode: Type-check governance JavaScript and tests without creating runtime output.
changed_surface_classification.observable_oracle: npm run typecheck succeeds with no emitted files.
